Closing the window just puts Mclash in the tray — the kernel and system proxy keep working, and your network stays connected.

· OK: minimize to the tray (to quit completely, right-click the tray icon → Quit)
· Cancel: quit Mclash completely, stop the kernel and restore the system proxy

(Your choice is remembered; next time you can use the tray icon directly)

settingItems.delayTestUrlTip:
Time for one full HTTP request through this node (it is not a ping)
Defaults to a plain http 204 empty response; using https adds a TLS handshake and a larger number
settingItems.tunModeTip:
off=system proxy only / auto=TUN+system proxy / force=TUN only
On desktop, TUN requires administrator privileges (wintun on Windows / utun on macOS)
settingItems.tunOverwriteTip:
overwrite
On = the TUN settings on this page override the tun section of the profile
Off = the profile's own tun configuration is used (the app does not interfere)

tunScreen.modeOffDesc: System proxy only: works for programs that honor the system proxy (browsers and so on); UDP/games are not proxied
tunScreen.modeAutoDesc: TUN + system proxy (belt and braces): all traffic goes through the virtual adapter, including UDP
tunScreen.modeForceDesc: TUN only: all traffic goes through the virtual adapter, the system proxy is left untouched
tunScreen.modeOffOptionDesc: Does not touch the system routing table; only sets a 127.0.0.1 proxy in the system. Only programs that honor the system proxy use it; UDP traffic and programs with their own proxy settings do not.
tunScreen.modeAutoOptionDesc: Creates a virtual adapter and takes over all traffic (including UDP and games); the system proxy is kept as a fallback. Recommended: it works globally and you are not left without network access if permissions are missing.
tunScreen.modeForceOptionDesc: Uses only the virtual adapter and no longer changes the system proxy. All traffic (including UDP) goes through the tunnel; the "proxy" entry in the system stays as it is.
tunScreen.adminRequiredDialog:
The TUN virtual adapter requires administrator privileges (wintun on Windows / utun on macOS).

Mclash is not running as administrator right now, so TUN will not take effect after enabling it (in "Auto" mode the system proxy still works as a fallback, so the network stays usable).

OK = restart Mclash as administrator now (a UAC prompt will appear)
Cancel = still save this choice (the system proxy is used automatically when TUN is unavailable)
